text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during the lead-up to the
Hanshin J.F.,
my colleague approaches
me while I'm eating
lunch in the
cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: I heard about your debut race.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
About you and that trainee of yours.
Apparently,
she threw a big fit and
caused everyone a lot of
hassle.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Get your act together. You're supposed
to be
guiding her!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
But that isn't to say that children don't
know the
right path themselves.

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Grandma
text_block_list.text:
They have their own compass, and it
works even
without any guidance from
adults. They're not
babies, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...? Hello? Anyone home?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Hanshin J.F. I go to
the spot
Sweep Tosho and I agreed to
meet, where I find
another Umamusume
there with her.
choice_data_list: ...Just lost in thought for a second.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Sweep. Wait.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The other day, when you were
half-asleep, I
heard you saying you
didn't want to race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If the situation you're in is hindering your
growth,
you should consider stepping
away from it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Which is to say, if you want to take a
break from
racing, take a break. If you
don't want to do
interviews, decline.
And if you need assistance, I'll
help you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Or is your trainer the source of your
anxiety? If
you want to change to
another trainer—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shaddup!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I hate stuff like this the most! I hate, hate, hate it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Talk about getting rejected.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(That's Tokai Teio. She's a charismatic

Umamusume who grabs people's hearts
and never
lets go. She even made a
miraculous recovery
after getting
injured.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So you saw that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're too motherly, Air Groove. That's
why
Sweep pushes you away.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Motherly"?! I'm just—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If you're that worried, just go watch her
race
without saying anything. There's
someone running
who I've got my eyes
on, so I'll be there too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like our relationship is a cause
of concern
not just for other trainers, but
for other
Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is pouting. I still don't
know how to
cheer her up when her
mood suddenly sours like
this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not her parent. We don't always
need to be
comforting each other. So in
that case...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Sweep, I know you can do it.
Sweep, I know you can do it.
